brief: Construct an array from values or spread arrays
description: Construct a new array from the given values (not a conversion function). Each argument becomes one element, in order. If a value is written as ...expression and the expression is an array, each of its entries is included in order. An empty call produces an empty array. A non-spread array argument is nested as a single element (array([1,2]) is [[1,2]]); use spread or a list literal to flatten. For a length of undefined slots use create_array(n).

parameters.description: A value can refer to any adaptable value belonging to any data type or an array expression. In the case of an array expression, indicated by '...' followed by an expression that results in an array, every element within that array is included in the newly created array.
parameters.name: values
